description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TravelBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SearchRequest" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SelectionProvided" name="Route, date and time selected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PersonalPaymentProvided" name="Personal and payment details provided"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TicketDelivery" name="Ticket delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ReminderInstructions" name="Reminder and check-in instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FeedbackProvided" name="Post-travel feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TravelBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelBooking"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SearchRequest" name="Search request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Selection" name="Selection" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Selection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PersonalPayment" name="Personal and payment details" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PersonalPayment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket" name="Ticket" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTicket" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminders" name="Reminders and instructions" sourceRef="SendTask_SendReminders" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelBooking" name="Travel Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SearchReceived" name="Customer searches for ticket">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Search" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Selection" name="Receive selected route, date and time" messageRef="Msg_SelectionProvided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_PersonalPayment" name="Receive personal information and payment details" messageRef="Msg_PersonalPaymentProvided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" name="Split ticket dispatch and inventory update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendTicket" name="Send ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Msg_TicketDelivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" name="Join ticket dispatch and inventory update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendReminders" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_ReminderInstructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted" name="Customer completes journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JourneyCompleted" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Post-travel feedback or services used?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Feedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackProvided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" name="Process concludes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Booking process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Selection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Selection" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PersonalPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_PersonalPayment" targetRef="ServiceTask_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="ServiceTask_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="SendTask_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" targetRef="SendTask_SendReminders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_SendReminders" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
